dialogue_texts: Berenice
Muh huh huh... Did you think all of my attacks were enough? You're already witnessing the rebirth of the Order...
Marisa
Ugh, your air is thicker than it was far away. I thought I finished the sweeping.
Berenice
It appears your "magic" hasn't left any residue. The glohm wasn't simply purged - it's moving.
Marisa
Moved? To where? It's not like it can get any weirder than it already is.
Berenice
Look at yourself. It's already feeding on your discarded magic.
Marisa
You have to be kidding me - the glohm is now taking me over!?
Berenice
You have failed to choose a reality, and society will now abandon you. You are now a resident of the Order.
Marisa
I can't start all over from scratch...
Berenice
I will learn to control your soul soon enough. The Order's power is not yet fully restored, but it will come in time.
Berenice
If you will become my faithful servant, I will not harm you.
Too bad! Bad ending! To see the good ending, clear the game without using a continue or letting nine hours pass.
